# Preserve native and exported dispatch for mixed and nested type switches.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nested_list_review328.lgo const_switch_nested_list_review328/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nested_list_review328.out const_switch_nested_list_review328/expected.txt
cd const_switch_nested_list_review328
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_mixed_default_review328.lgo const_switch_mixed_default_review328/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_mixed_default_review328.out const_switch_mixed_default_review328/expected.txt
cd const_switch_mixed_default_review328
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_live_list_review328.lgo const_switch_live_list_review328/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_live_list_review328.out const_switch_live_list_review328/expected.txt
cd const_switch_live_list_review328
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

-- const_switch_nested_list_review328/go.mod --
module example.com/const_switch_nested_list_review328

go 1.27

-- const_switch_mixed_default_review328/go.mod --
module example.com/const_switch_mixed_default_review328

go 1.27

-- const_switch_live_list_review328/go.mod --
module example.com/const_switch_live_list_review328

go 1.27
